doc.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Born in Kilwinning, raised in Dalry
summary: Galloway was born in Kilwinning but grew up in Dalry and moved to Glasgow as a student; Joe Temperley is mentioned.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You’re from Scotland, and I don’t know if I can pronounce — I’ll try — Kilwinning?

Well yeah. I was only there very briefly. I was born there in a nursing home. But my home and where I grew up was a little town four miles from there called Dalry, and that’s where I grew up before I moved into Glasgow when I was a student.
Okay. You probably know Joe Temperley.
